next_cycle.title: Backend: one-line fix — Str facade import in PasswordResetService
next_cycle.prompt:
ONE-LINE FIX. Nothing more.

The PR2 backend branch `feature/auth-p2-backend` has a broken import in `app/Services/Auth/PasswordResetService.php`.

## The bug

Line 11 imports `Illuminate\Support\Facades\Str` — this class does NOT exist in Laravel 13 (it was removed; `Str` is now a static-method helper class, not a facade). Calling `Str::random(60)` at line 136 fails with `Class "Illuminate\Support\Facades\Str" not found`.

This breaks `PasswordResetService::resetPassword()` and cascades into 5 of 13 PasswordResetTest cases:
- test_password_reset_link_marks_token_consumed_on_use
- test_password_reset_link_cannot_be_reused
- test_password_reset_invalidates_other_active_tokens
- test_password_reset_does_not_block_unverified_users
- test_password_reset_loglocks_user_in_after_success

## The fix

ONE LINE. In `app/Services/Auth/PasswordResetService.php`, change:
```php
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Str;
```
to:
```php
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
```

That's it. The static API surface is identical (`Str::random(60)` works either way), so no other lines need to change. This matches the convention used by every other file in the codebase: `app/Models/EmailVerificationToken.php:11`, `app/Http/Controllers/TagController.php:13`, `database/factories/UserFactory.php:8`.

## Workflow

1. Use the existing worktree at `/tmp/solar-auth-p2-backend` (it already has a real installed vendor and the worktree-pitfall workaround in place from the prior attempt).
2. Apply the one-line change.
3. Verify locally: `/opt/homebrew/opt/php@8.4/bin/php artisan test --filter='AuthTest|EmailVerificationTest'` — must be green (22/22). The full PasswordResetTest won't run here because the test file is owned by the test track, but you can sanity-check by importing the service in tinker: `/opt/homebrew/opt/php@8.4/bin/php -r 'require __DIR__."/vendor/autoload.php"; require __DIR__."/bootstrap/app.php"; new App\Services\Auth\PasswordResetService(); echo "OK\n";'`.
4. Commit on `feature/auth-p2-backend`:
   - `git config user.name "Henrique Della Manna"`
   - `git config user.email "henrique.dellamanna@gmail.com"`
   - `git add app/Services/Auth/PasswordResetService.php`
   - `git commit -m "fix(auth): import Str helper (not Facades\Str) in PasswordResetService"`
   - `git push origin feature/auth-p2-backend`
5. Write `deliverable.md` in the worktree root with: the one diff hunk, the test result line, the push confirmation (`git ls-remote origin feature/auth-p2-backend`).

Do NOT touch any other file. Do NOT refactor. Do NOT add tests. Do NOT touch the worktree's vendor. ONE LINE.
